title: lycopodiella torta
intro: Lycopodiella torta, commonly known as the variegated clubmoss, is a type of plant belonging to the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodiella torta include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
